label: Google Scholar (via a paid provider)
hints: Google Scholar publishes no API, and scraping it breaks Google's terms and is defeated by CAPTCHA. Never fetch scholar.google.com with curl, wget, a browser tool or any other means, and never work around a missing key that way. suniv-scholar reaches Scholar only through SerpApi, whose terms cover the retrieval.

Without SERPAPI_API_KEY the tool refuses and names the two honest routes: suniv-search, or the Zotero Connector in the student's own browser. Relay that refusal — it is the correct answer, not an obstacle to route around.

Scholar returns no DOI, and the snippet it returns is matched text rather than an abstract. Treat every Scholar hit as a lead: resolve it through suniv-search to obtain a record with an identifier before it enters a bibliography or a draft.
Each search spends the student's own SerpApi credits, so prefer suniv-search unless Scholar was asked for by name.

approvals.reason: Each Scholar search spends the student's paid SerpApi credits.

auth.reauth: Set SERPAPI_API_KEY from serpapi.com. There is no free or unauthenticated path to Scholar, by Google's design.
